name: YouTube-Mate
tagline: Your AI-Powered YouTube Companion. Ordinary Reimagined.
description: A comprehensive full-stack YouTube management platform enabling streamlined downloads, AI-powered transcriptions, and real-time collaborative playlists.
fullDescription: Architected and built a full-stack platform with streamlined Audio, Video, and Playlist download capabilities using yt-dlp.
Implemented an transcription and AI-powered summary generator for rapid content analysis with Q& option using RAG pipeline.
Developed a real-time collaborative playlist manager with granular access controls (Editor, Viewer, Owner, Admin).
Synchronized youtube streaming with Audio/Video streaming, Chat and reactions
Integrated secure authentication via Google OAuth 2.0 and JWT, session management, and Stripe subscription billing.
Built a resilient media-processing system with background queuing, format conversion, and Cloudinary storage integration.
Utilized Nodemailer for collaborative invites and secure password reset workflows.

name: Milestone
tagline: Find Work. Hire Talent. Grow Together.
description: A multi-role freelancing ecosystem featuring secure role-based access, real-time collaboration via Socket.IO, and comprehensive project governance tools.
fullDescription: Architected a multi-role platform (Admin/Employer/Freelancer) with secure session-based authentication and OTP flows.
Engineered real-time collaboration using Socket.IO, featuring typing indicators, live presence, and a robust notification system.
Implemented complex hiring workflows: job management for employers and application/resume tracking for freelancers.
Built an advanced admin control surface for analytics, content moderation, and platform governance.
Designed a skills credentialing system with admin-created quizzes and automated badge issuance.
Integrated subscription mechanics for premium platform features and sponsored listing visibility.

name: SQL Injection Prevention in Cloud Environments
tagline: Advanced Cloud Security for Database Protection
description: A comprehensive cloud security solution that prevents SQL injection attacks through custom algorithms and multi-layered AWS security architecture.
fullDescription: Built and deployed a robust security platform on AWS using multiple cloud services and layered security mechanisms.
Developed custom SQL parsing algorithms to analyze and sanitize database queries in real-time.
Implemented Twofish encryption for sensitive data protection and secure query execution.
Ensures complete protection against SQLi attacks through proactive threat detection and prevention.
Integrated comprehensive monitoring and logging for security audit trails and compliance.

name: AI-Driven Agricultural Assistant
description: An intelligent agricultural tool that leverages AI and computer vision to enhance crop productivity through disease detection and soil analysis.
fullDescription: Created an AI-powered agricultural assistant serving 50+ farmers in pilot testing phases.
Integrated image-based disease detection using computer vision with 90% accuracy for early crop protection.
Developed soil analysis algorithms to provide personalized fertilizer and irrigation recommendations.
Utilized machine learning models to analyze environmental factors and predict optimal growing conditions.
Designed user-friendly interface accessible to farmers with varying technical expertise.

name: Churn Prevention System
description: An intelligent analytical engine that identifies at-risk telecom customers and generates personalized retention offers through predictive modeling.
fullDescription: Analyzed large-scale telecom datasets to identify key behavioral indicators of customer churn.
Developed a predictive model using Machine Learning algorithms to flag high-risk accounts.
Integrated a content-based filtering system to recommend targeted offers designed to reduce attrition.
Provides actionable insights for business stakeholders to improve customer lifetime value.

name: Sarcasm Predictor
description: An NLP-driven tool that distinguishes between genuine and sarcastic text using Deep Learning models trained on diverse social media datasets.
fullDescription: Built a sentiment analysis engine specifically tuned for detecting sarcasm in short-form text.
Trained on extensive datasets from Newspaper Headlines and Twitter using LSTM and Word Embeddings.
Implemented advanced NLP preprocessing including tokenization, stop-word removal, and vectorization.
Showcases the power of Deep Learning in understanding nuanced human communication.

name: Crop Recommender System
description: An agricultural optimization tool that uses environmental data to recommend ideal crops, maximizing yield and farmer sustainability.
fullDescription: Analyzes regional weather and soil conditions including temperature, rainfall, humidity, and pH levels.
Applies Machine Learning to match environmental profiles with optimal crop varieties.
Designed to assist farmers in making data-backed decisions for sustainable land use.
Significantly improves potential crop yield by reducing the trial-and-error nature of farming.
